exposure: bioelectrical impedance analysis (BIA) measurements at first trimester (Total body Mass, FM, FFM, TBW, leg's FM, FFM)
elevated total body water levels in the first trimester
cohort: The study included singleton obese women (BMI >= 30 kg/m2) between 9 and 12 weeks of pregnancy, without chronic diseases like type 2 diabetes mellitus or pre-existing hypertension.
finding: Elevated total body water levels in the first trimester were associated with a higher risk of developing gestational hypertension.
mod_finding: A higher rate of induction of labor was found in the group of women who developed gestational hypertension.
followup_time: Up to 36 weeks of gestation and recording of perinatal outcomes (implying up to birth/immediate postpartum period)
gest_age: Cohort included between 9th and 12th week of pregnancy, followed up to 36 weeks of gestation.
